translations.web: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
translations.bsb: So they returned to the city quietly that day, as people steal away in humiliation after fleeing a battle.
translations.kjv: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
